scope: plugin side only; broadcaster-web changes are scanned in that repo

findings.description: Feed edit page waits on up to two Broadcaster requests (10 s timeout each).
findings.recommendation: Follow-up for a shorter render-path timeout or a short transient.

findings.description: API warning text escaped with esc_html; markup shown as text (unit and wp-env).
Template check goes only to the configured API URL; name encoded into the path; feed edit page only.
Spam-marked entries never run the feed; no dispatch path around Gravity Forms' spam gate.

notes: Instrument validation: phpcs security standard does not flag removed escaping on a returned string (mutation W1, exit 0); the unit tests do.
Secret-exposure grep validated against 66cfd84^ (BRO-1468); 3 hits in range, all the existing Bearer header path.
Web commit a6405fcaf (sends the warning) is on no broadcaster-web remote branch yet; the plugin shows nothing until it ships.
